core_claims.claim: The API exposes entity search through /entity.{extension}.
Entity output extensions include json html and geojson.
A single entity can be requested by integer entity identifier.
Dataset listing uses /dataset.{extension}.
Dataset listing supports repeated dataset filters.
Dataset listing supports field inclusion.
Dataset listing supports field exclusion.
include_typologies can remove typologies from dataset JSON.
Coordinate queries use latitude and longitude intersection semantics.
Multiple dataset parameters can be supplied in one entity request.
UPRN-style matching can be submitted through q.
UPRN matching is described as more precise than coordinate matching for registered properties.
geometry_entity can reuse another entity geometry as a spatial filter.
geometry_relation supports within-style spatial filtering.
Entity records include a dataset field.
Entity records include a name field where supplied.
Entity records can include start-date.
Entity geometry is represented as WKT.
Entity point is represented as WKT.
Bulk downloads are available from dataset pages.
Bulk formats include CSV and JSON.
GeoJSON and Parquet are available where applicable.
Parquet is positioned for large dataset processing.
The API remains beta and production integrations must tolerate change.
Limit controls result volume.
Field selection can reduce response payload.
Coverage varies by area.
No result must not be treated as proof of no planning constraint.
Exact target entity responses remain required for candidate binding.
Documentation alone does not provide candidate elevation values.
